questions.question: CQ1 未闭合缺口及其前置
questions.sparql: SELECT ?code ?status (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?p2; separator=",") AS ?precededBy) WHERE { ?g a ?gc . ?gc rdfs:subClassOf* cqm:Gap . ?g cqm:gapCode ?code ; cqm:status ?status . OPTIONAL { ?p cqm:gapPrecedes ?g . ?p cqm:gapCode ?pre } BIND(COALESCE(?pre, "") AS ?p2) } GROUP BY ?code ?status ORDER BY ?code
rows: 公式推导完成严格性待提升

questions.question: CQ2 缺证据的断言（应为空）
questions.sparql: SELECT ?s WHERE { { ?s a ?c1 . ?c1 rdfs:subClassOf* cqm:Concept } UNION { ?s a ?c2 . ?c2 rdfs:subClassOf* cqm:Proposition } UNION { ?s a cqm:Hyperedge } UNION { ?s a cqm:Argument } FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?s prov:wasDerivedFrom ?e } }

questions.question: CQ3 超边的前件闭包（一跳）
questions.sparql: SELECT ?h (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?pre; separator=",") AS ?premises) WHERE { ?h a cqm:Hyperedge ; cqm:hasPremise ?p . ?p skos:prefLabel ?pre } GROUP BY ?h ORDER BY ?h LIMIT 25
rows: 中子缺陷矩阵,A4嘉当矩阵
Mathieu临界,谱修正,第一耦级,Dynkin指数比,相变量子

questions.question: CQ4 缺口依赖链（传递闭包）
CQ5 被最多断言提及的概念
questions.sparql: SELECT ?name (COUNT(?s) AS ?n) WHERE { ?s cqm:mentionedIn ?c . ?c skos:prefLabel ?name } GROUP BY ?name ORDER BY DESC(?n) LIMIT 8

questions.question: CQ6 形式化覆盖（有 Lean 映射的概念）
CQ7 别名 → 规范名
questions.sparql: SELECT ?alias ?name WHERE { ?c skos:altLabel ?alias ; skos:prefLabel ?name } ORDER BY ?alias LIMIT 40

questions.question: CQ8 出处文档分布
questions.sparql: SELECT ?doc (COUNT(DISTINCT ?s) AS ?n) WHERE { ?s cqm:sourceDoc ?doc } GROUP BY ?doc ORDER BY DESC(?n) LIMIT 10

questions.question: CQ9 未闭合缺口的证据句
questions.sparql: SELECT ?code ?q WHERE { ?g cqm:gapCode ?code ; cqm:status "未闭合" ; prov:wasDerivedFrom ?e . ?e prov:value ?q } ORDER BY ?code
